text:
samir: morning — heads-up: we have a small cluster of blocking PRs spanning redwood-sdk, redwood-api, console, and the helm chart. want to unclog the pipeline before tomorrow's canary. :eyes:

taylor: can you list the exact blockers? i can pick up SDK review but need the API contract change details.

samir: sdk PR is on feature/compact-client, waiting on API header change (auth header rename). api PR hasn't landed. console needs the client bump and helm needs a new env value. short checklist below.

ravi: the API change is adding `x-rwd-auth` header instead of `authorization` for a couple of flows (backwards-compatible for now). i'll post the small diff in a sec. @ingrid any chance we can accept both headers for a transition window?

ingrid: yes — we can add a shim in the router to accept old header and set a deprecation metric. i'll open a tiny PR (no schema break). ETA ~16:00 PST. :thumbsup:

samir: that would let SDK land early and console follow with a client bump. SDK tests rely on the header shape so we can't skip this.

marko: helm needs to expose an env var `RWD_AUTH_HEADER` to make the runtime configable. i'll prepare chart patch and upgrade notes after the shim merges.

jessica: runtime team — can you confirm KV cache behavior won't be impacted when header name toggles? we don't want auth changes invalidating caches. @deploy-bot can we run a quick staging deploy after the SDK merge?

deploy-bot: staging-deploy queued for redwood-sdk@feature/compact-client — build 543 in pipeline. will post status updates.

pri_aws: i'm on call but can review and approve k8s manifest changes after a quick peek. ping me when chart PR is ready.

samir: taylor — i pasted the curl example for the new header in the SDK PR description: `curl -H "x-rwd-auth: <token>" https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate`

taylor: picking up SDK review now. left a couple tiny nits (formatting + one flaky test). nothing blocking. @samir can you address?

samir: fixed formatting and added a deterministic unit test to cover header fallback. pushed. PTAL @taylor

taylor: LGTM, approving. :white_check_mark:

ravi: API shim PR opened: redwood-api#982 — router accepts both headers, emits `auth_header_deprecated` metric. no functionality change. please validate with local SDK.

samir: validated locally against api#982 — all tests pass, integration looks good. merging SDK PR and cutting a client tag now.

marko: helm chart PR created: charts/redwood#78 — adds `RWD_AUTH_HEADER` with default `authorization` and notes to upgrade guide. holding merge until console client bump lands to avoid rolling mismatch.

ingrid: i'll monitor logs for 24h post-merge and plan to drop deprecation warning in two weeks once adoption metrics look good.

jessica: wrote a short rollout checklist in the console PR description covering: SDK tag bump, helm value, staging deploy, SRE smoke tests. i'll coordinate the staging window and notify SRE when deploy-bot reports success.

samir: thanks all — plan: (1) merge api shim, (2) merge SDK, (3) tag + bump console, (4) merge helm chart. i'll watch the staging deploy and open a follow-up if anything flares. ping here for any post-merge issues. :party_parrot:
